title: Proud Tek Markets: Country and Regional Buyer Pages
summary: Proud Tek ships custom RFID and NFC products globally. The country pages below collect the procurement, compliance, and logistics context that matters for each market: applicable radio regulations, customs documentation, regional reseller programs, and language support. Use this hub to jump straight to the country page that matches your shipping destination.
heroPoints: 10 country and regional buyer pages with market-specific compliance and logistics notes.
Each page covers radio compliance (FCC, CE, MIC, IC), customs documentation, and regional certifications.
Pricing is in USD by default; per-country payment, incoterm, and currency options available on request.

brief.label: Coverage
items: Shipping support: DHL, FedEx, EMS for air; sea freight FOB Shenzhen or Yantian for bulk.
Documentation: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, RoHS / REACH declarations.
Languages: English by default; Chinese, Spanish, and Arabic available on request.
Payment: TT, LC, PayPal for sample orders; LC at sight or 30/70 TT for production orders.

sections.title: Why a country-specific page matters for RFID and NFC
sections.intro: Buyers in different markets face different procurement realities. Radio regulations differ (FCC in the US, CE/RED in Europe, MIC in Japan, IC in Canada). Customs documentation differs. Even chip families face regional preferences: UHF deployments are dominant in the US retail market, while HF/MIFARE remain dominant in European hospitality. The country pages below pre-populate the conversation with the relevant context.
bullets: Radio regulations: FCC Part 15/18, CE EN 300 330, MIC, IC, CCC.
Customs documentation: certificate of origin, EUR.1, ATR, TÜV inspection where applicable.
Industry mandates: Walmart UHF (US), EU DPP (Europe), DSCSA pharmaceutical traceability (US).
Logistics partner preferences: DHL Europe, FedEx Asia-Pacific, EMS for emerging markets.
Currency and payment: USD default; EUR, GBP, JPY, AED on request.

sections.title: Where Proud Tek serves
sections.intro: We have shipped to buyers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, South Asia, and the Asia-Pacific. The 10 dedicated country pages cover the markets where we have the deepest deployment experience.
bullets: North America: United States, Canada (consolidated under USA page).
Europe: Germany, United Kingdom; broader EU served through both pages.
Middle East and Africa: UAE / Dubai, South Africa, Africa (regional).

sections.title: What you will not find on the country pages
sections.intro: Country pages are about procurement context, not pricing or stock. We deliberately avoid putting per-country price lists online because chip costs change weekly and regional duties shift the landed cost more than the chip price.
bullets: No public price lists. Pricing is BOM-level on quote.
No published stock levels. We confirm availability against your order in real time.
No local-warehouse claim. All inventory is in Shenzhen; transit times are honest.
No fake regional offices. Proud Tek operates only from Shenzhen.

faq.question: Can you ship to my country if it is not listed?
faq.answer: Almost certainly. The country pages cover markets where we have repeat deployments, but we ship globally via DHL, FedEx, and EMS. Email info@proudtek.com or message WhatsApp +86 186 6582 0632 with your destination and we will confirm logistics options.

faq.question: Do you have a local office in my country?
faq.answer: No. Proud Tek operates from Shenzhen with no overseas office. Local DHL, FedEx, or EMS handle delivery. Some buyers prefer this because it eliminates intermediate margin; others prefer a local representative. We are honest about the trade-off.

faq.question: How do regional radio regulations affect my UHF deployment?
faq.answer: UHF frequency allocations differ by region: 902–928 MHz in North America (FCC), 865–868 MHz in Europe (CE/RED), 916–921 MHz in Japan (MIC). Tag antennas are tuned for the regulatory band. We confirm the band on every UHF order to avoid range or compliance issues at the destination.

faq.question: Which incoterms do you support?
faq.answer: EXW Shenzhen, FOB Shenzhen, FOB Yantian, CIF named port, and DDP for select destinations. DDP is available where our logistics partners can pre-clear customs reliably. Smaller orders default to DAP via DHL or FedEx.
